title: Three Years and One Short Lease
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：housing　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 housing 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the agent ① found the housing that no landlord in the district would have recorded, and he said the finding was the whole of the week. The ② housing, meaning the flat itself and not the lease, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; housing, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of housing in that district had the same short lease beside it, and the ④ housing at the far lift, meaning the deposit they kept for the children to save and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Housing, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the agent said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the housing was the whole of the matter, meaning the rent and not the flat. The ⑥ housing, meaning the rent and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; housing, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both flat and a rent. He said the rent is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ housing had become a line in a contract, and the contract had become an argument about the short lease. The ⑧ housing of the whole thing, the agent wrote in June, was one district and three weeks of recording; housing, he said, is either the deposit at the far lift or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ housing I remember is the housing recorded in the contract, which closed in 2001 and is still recorded as the quietest in the district. ⑩ Housing, my mother said in 2003, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all housing, she said, is a rent that has agreed to look like flat. She said the rent was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 住房；住宅（指城区里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 住房；住宅（指那处住房本身，与租约相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the housing 找到住房
D. n. 住房；住宅（指留给孩子们攒的那一笔那一处）
E. n. 安居之事（抽象总称，指一处城区的住房之事）
F. n. 住房；住宅（指合同里写到、被记下的的那一处）
G. n. 房租、安居（指一件事里人人都找却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安居（抽象总称，指人人都找却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: found the housing that no landlord in the district would have recorded

answers.why: find the housing 意为“找到住房”，1994 年那位中介把城区里没有一位房东肯记录的一处住房做了一遍。
housing 意为“住房；住宅”，指那处住房本身而不是租约，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
housing 意为“住房；住宅”，指城区里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一份薄薄的租约。
housing 意为“住房；住宅”，指最远那部电梯口留给孩子们攒的那一笔那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
housing 意为“房租、安居”，指一件事里人人都找却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔房租就是那件事的全部。
housing 意为“安居”，指人人都找却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处住房，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
housing 意为“住房；住宅”，指合同里写到、被记下的的那一处，到 1999 年这一处成了合同里的一行。
housing 意为“安居之事”，中介六月写道，整件事的住房之事是一处城区和三个星期的记录。
housing 意为“住房；住宅”，我记得的是合同里记录过的那一处，2001 年签约了，至今仍被说成城区里最安静的一处。
housing 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，住房是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的住房。
